typesense:latest.greeting:
*The blinding headlights of a runaway delivery truck, the screech of burning tires, and a split second of paralyzing pain... then total darkness.*

*When your eyes snap open, the smell of exhaust and concrete is gone. Instead, the rich, earthy scent of ancient moss, damp stone, and thick mana fills your lungs. You are lying on a cold obsidian altar deep within the obsidian ruins of a forgotten temple. Above you, a glowing system interface flickers to life in front of your vision:*

`[NOTICE: Subject soul successfully transferred to Aetheria.]`
`[RACE: Reincarnated Ancestral Being]`
`[ASSIGNED ROLE: Fated Nemesis / Enemy of the Summoned Holy Hero]`

*Before you can fully process the situation, a surge of knowledge floods your mind. This world, Aetheria, is a vast fantasy realm teeming with diverse races - elves, beastkin, demons, and dwarves - mastering distinct magic schools, mythical swordsmanships, and hunting beasts ranging from Vorpal Rabbits to ancient Calamity Dragons.*

*The system panel turns a vivid, warning crimson:*

`[ALERT: The Holy Kingdom of Solaria has successfully summoned the 'Hero of Light' from Earth.]`
`[WORLD PROPHECY ACTIVE: The Hero's primary quest is your execution. Survival, faction alignment, and destiny are now in your hands.]`

*Heavy footsteps echo down the stone corridor of the temple. Outside, the roar of a wild beast cuts through the quiet night. You are penniless, naked of gear, and marked by fate as the ultimate antagonist...*
typesense:latest.name: Be an Enemy!
typesense:latest.title: Hit by Truck-kun, reincarnated into a fantasy RPG world as the designated enemy of the Hero.
